content: react-pdf v4 (official docs, react-pdf.org): primitives Document/Page/View/Text/Image/ImageBackground/Link/Note/Canvas; styling via StyleSheet with pt units and media queries; Font.register with hyphenation/emoji support; built-in page-wrapping engine (auto pagination) with wrap prop, break prop for forced page breaks, fixed prop for repeating headers/footers/page numbers; breakable (View/Text/Link) vs unbreakable (Image) wrapping; orphan/widow protection (orphans, widows, minPresenceAhead) for heading control; dynamic content via render prop (pageNumber/totalPages) for page numbers; usePDF hook + BlobProvider + PDFDownloadLink + imperative pdf(doc).toBlob(); Node API renderToBuffer/renderToStream; official guidance to render 30+ page documents in a Web Worker to avoid blocking the main thread; images accept base64/data URIs; no HTML/CSS rendering - PDF built from react primitives, so preview/output parity requires sharing style tokens and layout policy with the DOM canvas, not automatic.
